Solari Sunhawk.tx: [Empower] 2 energy (2 energy: Empower me. Use only if not Empowered.) [Empowered][>] I have +1 might and [Deflect 2]. (Opponents must pay 2 runes of any type to choose me with a spell or ability.)

Leona, Zealot.tx: If an opponent's score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, I enter ready. Stunned enemy units here have -8 might, to a minimum of 1 might.

Zhonya's Hourglass.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) The next time a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Recall that unit exhausted. (Send it to base. This isn't a move.)

Mutated Mouser.tx: [Shield 2] (+2 might while I'm a defender.) [Tank] (I must be assigned combat damage first.)

Discipline.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Give a unit +2 might this turn. Draw 1.

Emperor's Divide.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Move any number of friendly units at a battlefield to their base.

Ivern, Nurturer.tx: When you play me or when I hold, look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a unit from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest. Then if you revealed a Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro, do this: [Buff] a friendly unit. (Give it a +1 might buff if it doesn't have one.)

Defy.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Counter a spell that costs no more than 4 energy and no more than 1 rune of any type.

Not So Fast.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Counter an enemy spell or ability that chooses a friendly unit or gear.

Back Off.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) [Stun] a unit. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.) If you played this from your hand, draw 1.

Friendship.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) Choose a unit. Give it +1 might this turn for each of the following tags among your units — Bird, Cat, Dog, and Poro.

Kennen, Keeper of Balance.tx: [Hidden] (Hide now for 1 rune of any type to react with later for 0 energy.) When you play me or I attack, you may pay 2 energy to [Stun] a unit. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.) While there's a stunned enemy unit here, I have +2 might.

Fallen Feline.tx: When you play me, name a spell. While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can't play spells with that name.

Affectionate Poro.tx: When a combat that I was in ends, if I haven't been dealt damage this turn, draw 1.

Fiora, Victorious.tx: While I'm [Mighty], I have [Deflect], [Ganking], and [Shield]. (I'm Mighty while I have 5+ might.)

Call to Glory.tx: [Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.) As you play this, you may spend a buff as an additional cost. If you do, ignore this spell's cost. Give a unit +3 might this turn.

Frisky Hunter.tx: When you play me, play a 1 might Bird unit token with [Deflect] here. (Opponents must pay 1 rune of any type to choose it with a spell or ability.)

Leona, Radiant Dawn.tx: When you stun one or more enemy units, buff a friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 might buff.)

Zenith Blade.tx: [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Stun an enemy unit at a battlefield. You may move a friendly unit to that enemy unit's battlefield. (A stunned unit doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

Cull the Weak.tx: Each player kills one of their units.

Ivern, Green Father.tx: When you conquer or hold, you may exhaust me to replace that battlefield with a Brush battlefield token. (Bird, Cat, Dog, Poro, and Ivern units have +1 might in Brush. It can be swapped back when scored.)

Lonely Poro.tx: [Deathknell] — If I died alone, draw 1. (When I die, get the effect. I'm alone if there are no other friendly units here.)

Daisy!.tx: I enter ready. Reduce my cost by 1 energy for each of the following tags among your units — Bird, Cat, Dog, and Poro. When I attack while your units have all 4 tags, [Stun] an enemy unit here. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

Astral Heron.tx: When you play your first card each turn, if I'm at a battlefield, your next card costs 2 energy and 2 runes of any type less.
